data.body: **[P1] Preserve existing raw checkpoint payloads during replay.** Persisted operations currently contain raw `SerDes` strings, and the disabled-offloading fast path also emits no envelope. This unconditional decoding pipeline would parse those values as `OffloadedPayload`, breaking in-flight executions after an SDK upgrade. Specify that data without the reserved envelope marker is treated as legacy inline data, while recognized malformed or unsupported envelopes fail closed, and require upgrade/replay tests.
